items.text: plugin-coherence-auditor subagent run for this plugin id and its report read in full; every high/medium finding folded into the fact sheet, consistency, or editorial phases below (evidence: report head SHA, finding count, coverage line)
Plugin id and change type identified; CLAUDE.md, the master README template, and the shape template read fresh
make check and make versions pass (evidence: the summary lines)
Every runtime file read; fact sheet written (components, reads/writes, network, requirements and where each is enforced, surfaces, value, limits)
Every row of references/consistency-matrix.md compared against the sources (evidence: rows checked / failing)
README reviewed per references/readme-editorial-review.md, as a first-time visitor and against the fact sheet, including the root catalog row
README format matches the other shipped plugins (sections, emojis, badges, tables, alerts, voice), not only the templates (evidence: plugins compared)

plugin.json and the marketplace.json entry use every field the plugin's nature calls for, including category and tags; nothing copied unchanged by a generator where more is needed (evidence: fields reviewed)

/code-review high on the diff, /security-review when scripts/hooks/MCP/LSP ship, /claude-api prompt-audit on skills and agents; findings fixed or deferred (evidence: summaries, or the plugin-design Phase 10 run's summaries if the head SHA hasn't changed since)
Phase 6 report with verdict and evidence-backed findings presented to the user
Every finding fixed, or explicitly deferred by the user (mark needs-user until they decide); runtime fixes bumped the version with a CHANGELOG entry
Each new class of finding closed: automated check with a test, a reference or rule in this skill, contributing guide / PR template, and a debt-ledger entry
make check passes after all fixes
